contracts.argument: D304 inspects offsets17..26 untilFF or ten entries. A<10 proves a currentFF within17..26. Every trusted path to the four sites passes that accepting edge. Between it and the final read/append, city0036 is unchanged and no real30city roster byte is written. The subsequent D105 reloads that same city pointer. Hence the same vacancy is still in17..26. Rawcity IDs30..255 have base>=63C0, so even unknownY0..255 cannot intersect the target city area.
contracts.scope: Ordinary no-interrupt/no-external-mutation execution through the original guarded entry, within the frozen trusted-CFG/helper contracts. Bare suffix entry is not covered; the original raw suffix can still read/write tail/nextcity bytes. Not a guarantee of termination or arbitrary raw control entry.
